No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements (div/span/select/option/input/textarea/button), window/document, react-i18next, lucide-react, @/components/ui, Recharts, or Leaflet appear in the native output — only React (useCallback/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState), react-native primitives (Modal/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), the native AppText/GlassPanel, the design tokens, and the ported NotificationChannel/AutomationActionKind/AutomationActionStep types. The web flex-wrap field rows map to flexDirection row + flexWrap wrap with the Tailwind widths (w-48->192, w-64->256, w-44->176, w-36->144, w-28->112, all maxWidth '100%') so they wrap on narrow screens; the `<select>` becomes a Modal popover anchored under the measured trigger (fallback top position in headless tests). A focused __tests__/ActionBuilder.test.tsx (15 tests) exercises the ACTION_TYPES order, per-index row rendering, add/remove/move + boundary-disabled, action-type replace-with-default (enabled-channel seeding), the four command-params JSON branches, notify channel parse + message + disabled-option, the set_setting number/boolean value-type swaps, and the call_automation numeric parse.
